summary: Round-2 confirmation of head 0b28c7c (polishA r2): jShell #434349 -> #4a4b51, jCap #4b4b50 -> #4b4c51, jBand back to #656b73 on the satin plastic layer. Shells lift ~8-17 % in shade while keeping the slate cast: q09 privacy wall (250-520 x 240-330) L47 h235 -> L55 h229; q06 near shell (0-120 x 380-560) L71 -> L79 h214; q06 caps L105 -> L112; q09 aisle wall L100 -> L107. The near walls in q09 / q10 now read mid charcoal against c_27314 rather than black-slate. Hue stays in the official cool range (h214-235, s0.05-0.10). The change is broad but small; the overall read is unchanged at 8.5. Lighting noted, not scored.
